verdict.rationale: The `ccloud` CLI can create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters, and Basic/Serverless clusters scale Request Unit consumption to zero when idle, which supports cheap per-tenant or preview databases. Cockroach Continuum also offers cluster virtualization so developers and agents can deploy virtual clusters on a dedicated host. However, nothing shows fleet-scale provisioning at thousands of databases, and nothing documents a fleet-management API or limits. Missing for 10: evidence of creating thousands of isolated databases cheaply, a documented programmatic provisioning API or SDK for fleet management, per-database cost and quota details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
